body: AZ Chike clears up rumors about the infamous missing Kendrick verse from his album… all that being said, I do hope that we will see them on another track together at some point in the future. My dream would actually be to see him Tyler and Chike all on a song together straight bars. But we will have to wait and see! For now everyone should just enjoy the dope album that Chike dropped.
